svg.text: Animal Facts API — System Architecture & Services
End-to-end service overview: Docker stack, request lifecycle, storage, and completed challenge features
Resource Routes: /cat-facts & /dog-facts with ->whereNumber('id') (Hardened against non-numeric IDs)
StoreRequest: fact required, string, max:255 [FIXED: authorize() returns true]
IndexRequest: pageSize optional, integer, min:1, max:100 (defaults to 25)
• Exceptions Handler: Sanitizes 500 responses; logs via report() (Zero SQL/credential leak - CWE-209)
• darkaonline/l5-swagger: Generates OpenAPI 3.0 specification from PHP docblock annotations
• Deterministic Ordering: All pagination calls enforce ->orderBy('id', 'asc')
Isolates automated tests from prod data
Default 25 items per page, pageSize param (min:1, max:100)
Interactive UI at /api/documentation and JSON spec at /doc
ForceJsonResponse, whereNumber regex routes, CWE-209 safe
52 PHPUnit tests (161 assertions), Pint PSR-12 clean, and
